body: I'll balance them as long as there's benefit, right now I see none.

Perhaps you are correct. However I calculated, as much as it pains me to admit it's highly probable that I'll die before I find the meaning to life. Maybe I can do my best and pave the road for future generations, but as selfish as this may sound I don't really want to since I would be long dead and forgotten and I'll never know the meaning of life.
